name: browser-act
description: BrowserAct skills for browser automation and reusable website-skill generation via the browser-act CLI.

interface.longDescription: BrowserAct provides browser automation through the browser-act CLI and a workflow for exploring websites and generating reusable Skills. Use it for rendered web content, browser workflows, or building a reusable site-specific Skill after exploration.
defaultPrompt: Use BrowserAct to extract the rendered content from this URL and summarize the key information.
Use browser-act-skill-forge to create a reusable Skill for collecting product listings from a specified website.
